correctness.rationale: Exact prefix identities yield block sums (B_k Q_{4n+2k+2}-k)/16 and (B_k Q_{4n+2k+2}+k)/2. For odd k, successive-difference GCDs are B_k and 8B_k respectively because Pell terms on the relevant 2 mod 4 index progression have common factor exactly 2. The first balancing block then gives gcd(B_k,k) modulo odd B_k. For Lucas-balancing, B_k congruent to k mod 4 and Q_{2k+2} congruent to 1 mod 4 make the first block sum odd, eliminating the extra power of 2 and leaving the same gcd.

value.rationale: The result settles every odd window length simultaneously for two of the four sequences in an explicit published open problem. It proves rather than assumes the source's experimentally observed odd-branch equality and identifies its exact common value as the natural sequence-index invariant gcd(B_k,k). The parity branch is structurally motivated by the source's braid formulas and is not an arbitrary finite restriction.
